Try: "Give me 3 different versions: one short, one friendly, one formal. Tell me which you'd pick and why."
Then mix the best parts into your own final draft.

scenes.say: The first AI answer is just one option. Ask for three.

scenes.title: Ask for three versions
scenes.user: Give me 3 versions of this headline: short, friendly, formal. Which would you pick?
scenes.reply:
1. Short: Fix Slow Sites Fast
2. Friendly: Let's Speed Up Your Site
3. Formal: A Guide to Faster Websites
I'd pick 2.
scenes.say: Try this. Give me three versions: short, friendly, and formal. Then ask which one it would pick. Now you can compare, instead of settling for the first try.

scenes.title: Get better drafts
items: Ask which it would pick, and why
scenes.say: Three steps. Ask for three versions. Ask which one it would pick, and why. Then mix the best parts yourself.
One answer means you take what you get. Three answers let you choose what fits.
